summary.headline: Planetary Aspects and Mastery
summary.text: Astrological judgments on mastery and livelihood according to planetary aspects: Mercury signifies writing, arithmetic, wealth, and intellect; Saturn agriculture and dominion; Jupiter writing and oratory; Mars medicine, seership, or necromancy; the Sun royal mastery; the Moon knowledge and fortune; Venus connections with royal and noble women. A profection of the radix ascendant to the midheaven renews mastery when a significator is present.
